messages:
Elena: Heads-up: Ben's turning 30 next Tue (4/20). Thinking of a low-key after-hours mini bash in the lounge at 6:30pm. Karaoke corner? :microphone:
Rory: Karaoke!! I'm in. I can bring a Bluetooth speaker and mic.
Sam: Love a karaoke corner. Can we also do a little memory board? sticky notes + photos.
people-ops-bot: Budget note: tag `POPS-31`. Please react with :tada: if you can attend in person.
Zoe: :tada: I'll be there and can print a small "Happy 30" sign. Any dietary needs for snacks?
Cal: I'll be remote but can send a short clip and chip in $15 for snacks/gift card.
Elena: Thanks Cal! Remote clips are great. For snacks: finger sandwiches, veggie tray, and cupcakes? Vote below.
Rory: Cupcakes :cupcake: and veggie tray :leafy_green: please.
Sam: Finger sandwiches :sandwich: are handy. Also does anyone know if Ben likes chocolate cake or fruity?
Zoe: He prefers chocolate. Also he's gluten-free most days, so maybe GF cupcakes too.
people-ops-bot: Poll created  react with :cupcake:, :sandwich:, or :leafy_green:. Poll ends Mon 3pm.
Elena: I'll order 12 cupcakes (2 GF chocolate) and finger sandwiches. If anyone wants to contribute to a "nicer" gift card, reply here.
Rory: I'll kick in $10 for the gift card.
Sam: $10 from me as well.
Cal: Sent $15.
Elena: Awesome. Who's manning karaoke DJ duties? Rory?
Rory: Happy to DJ. Playlist suggestions welcome. Keep it 90s/indie/some guilty pleasures.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled Tue 5:30pm "Set up for Ben's 30th".
Zoe: I'll put together the memory board and leave a sticky-note stack at reception. Remote folks DM pics to me and I'll print.
Elena: Thank you! Last ask: anyone bring balloons or confetti? No confetti pls, sticky balloons only :sweat_smile:.
Sam: I'll bring a small balloon bouquet (no confetti).
Elena: Perfect. See you all Tue 6:30. Remote clips due by Mon EOD. :tada:
